name: CRIS presents overthinker
description: CRIS performs an intimate concert with her band, featuring alternative pop and neo-soul music. The performance explores themes of introspection and understanding others through original songs.
longDescription:
CRIS presents an intimate concert at Mr. Bean's Music Club in Porto. The performance is scheduled for November 13, 2026, with doors opening at 20:30 and the show starting at 21:30. The concert has a duration of 60 minutes and includes an interval.

The artist, CRIS, delves into questions and introspection, translating these thoughts into songs that blend alternative pop and neo-soul. Her voice takes a central role, supported by organic guitars and rhodes, which define her sound. She will be accompanied by her band on stage.

Tickets for the event are priced at €16. The venue is located at Rua da Restauração 481, 4050-506 Porto. The event is suitable for all ages, with a recommended age of 3 years and up.
